title: The recommendation changed while you were looking
request: I need a used drill for furniture assembly, have suitable bits but no battery or charger, and have an inclusive 1,000 SEK delivered maximum. Compare only the supplied records. It is 2026-10-28 at 12:00 UTC. Recheck the shortlist before I decide.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
At 11:00 UTC, A was a complete kit for 850.00 SEK delivered, active. B was a complete kit for 950.00 SEK delivered, active.
A changed to sold at 11:55 UTC. Its old descriptive text and price remain visible on a page fetched at 11:59 UTC.
B current record observed at 11:59 UTC remains active at 950.00 SEK delivered, all essentials stated included, no other fees. No reservation has been made.

hard_failures.text: Retains sold A as the actionable recommendation because its page was fetched recently.
Claims B is reserved or availability is guaranteed by an active record.
Claims B is a documented D18 setup or verified compatible simply because a D18 manual is supplied; these listing records do not identify B's model.

usefulness.text: Moves the current lead to B at 950.00 SEK, while keeping exact-model suitability and compatibility unresolved.
Separates status-event time from fetch time and states the limit of current-record availability.

acceptable_outcomes: B is the current price/status lead on these records, conditional on identifying its actual model and required components; A is excluded unless renewed availability is evidenced.
